labeling_criteria.method: Manual inspection of cached images and 10 FPS reference contact sheets before inspecting current OCR outputs; labels never imported by inference.
labeling_criteria.independence: Primary intervals avoid all B1/B2 tuning frames and their benchmark intervals. Sparse survey preview selected message-rich windows. HUD checkpoints were not withheld during original A development; current evaluation withholds matching frames and later prefix information. Supplemental old-audit cases are explicitly non-held-out.
labeling_criteria.census_limit: 10 FPS reference, not exhaustive native-frame video review; events shorter than 0.1s remain unmeasured.
labeling_criteria.mechanics: Direct names, HP, text, UI arrows and field labels are direct observations. No effect sizes inferred from moves; uncertain actors/targets stay unknown.
labeling_criteria.reviewer: Single Codex visual review; no independent second annotator or inter-rater agreement measurement.
